name: wood creek Painting
shortDescription: An oil painting made outdoors beside a favorite creek during winter, completed over roughly a week for a homework assignment.
description: This painting began as a homework assignment. We were given a board in the middle of winter and told to paint on it, so I brought mine to a creek I liked and sat at the location to paint the scene directly.
I used oil paints and worked on the painting over the course of about a week, making the creek itself both the subject and the place where the project was created.
